state_info.name: California
state_info.board_notice_desc: Notify CA Board of Pharmacy within 72 hours if ePHI or controlled substance data compromised.
state_info.notes: California requires breach notification to affected residents without unreasonable delay. For pharmacies, CA BOP may also require incident reporting if controlled substance data is involved.

individual_notice.description: Notify affected individuals via first-class mail (or email if authorized per 164.522).

hhs_secretary_notice.description: Notify HHS Secretary via breach portal (https://ocrportal.hhs.gov/ocr/breach/breach_report.jsf).

media_notice.description: Notify prominent media outlets in the state/jurisdiction if >500 individuals affected.

state_pharmacy_board_notice.description: Notify CA Board of Pharmacy within 72 hours if ePHI or controlled substance data compromised.

business_associate_notice.description: Notify all business associates (BAs) covered by HIPAA BAA within 60 days.

checklist_items.task: Contain the breach and preserve evidence (memory dumps, disk images, logs).
Conduct risk assessment per 164.402(2): determine probability of compromise.
Document all affected individuals, data types, and systems involved.
Notify California State Board of Pharmacy within 72 hours.
Notify affected individuals via first-class mail (or email if authorized).
Notify HHS Secretary via OCR Breach Portal.
Notify prominent media outlets in the affected state/jurisdiction.
Notify all Business Associates (BAs) per BAA terms.
Offer credit monitoring / identity theft protection if warranted.
File FBI IC3 report (Internet Crime Complaint Center).
Update policies and procedures to prevent recurrence.
